en.headline: Hong Kong non-exchange-traded product sales hit record HK$9.9 trillion in 2025
en.dek: A joint SFC-HKMA survey showed a 63 per cent rise driven by strong demand for fixed-income, currency and commodity products and record market participation.

zh.headline: 去年非交易所買賣投資產品銷售創9.9萬億元新高
zh.dek: 證監會與金管局聯合調查顯示按年急升63%，受惠於固定收益、貨幣及商品產品需求強勁及市場參與度破紀錄。

en.headline: Record 16 young Hong Kong officers recommended for UN Junior Professional posts
en.dek: The third batch, drawn from 12 government departments and bureaux, will begin two-year assignments this month at UN headquarters and offices in Geneva, Vienna and Nairobi.

zh.headline: 歷來最多16名青年公務員獲推薦赴聯合國任職
zh.dek: 第三批人員來自12個政府部門及政策局，本月起陸續啓程，於聯合國總部及日內瓦、維也納、內羅畢辦事處擔任兩年職位。

en.headline: Black Kite’s Flockfest brings craft beer and indie music to PMQ this weekend
en.dek: The three-day free-entry festival from 11 to 13 September features eight Hong Kong and Japanese breweries, more than 50 beers, local food and live sets by 15 indie acts.

zh.headline: 黑鳶Flockfest周末PMQ舉行 精釀啤酒與本地獨立音樂
zh.dek: 9月11至13日於中環元創方免費入場，匯聚港日八間酒廠逾50款啤酒、本地美食及15組獨立音樂單位。

en.headline: Development chief says Queen Mary lift shafts have dimensional deviations
en.dek: Secretary Ning Hoi-tak said installation workmanship, damaged components and shaft wall size errors are being fixed, with rectification expected in the fourth quarter and costs borne by the contractors.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪：瑪麗醫院𨋢槽外牆尺寸有偏差 料第四季完成執修
zh.dek: 發展局局長表示升降機問題涉及安裝工藝、部件破損及井道外牆尺寸偏差，當局有信心今年第四季完成執修，費用由承建商支付。

en.headline: Female officer burned after paper shredder fire at Wan Chai police HQ
en.dek: A shredder ignited inside an office in the West Wing of Police Headquarters shortly before 11am; the officer was taken conscious to Ruttonjee Hospital with facial and arm burns.

zh.headline: 灣仔警總碎紙機起火 女警面及手燒傷送院
zh.dek: 今早近11時警察總部西翼辦公室碎紙機起火，一名女警面部及雙手前臂燒傷，清醒送往律敦治醫院。

en.headline: LCSD Mid-Autumn lanterns light Victoria Park from 17 September
en.dek: The carnival at Victoria Park runs to 27 September, with a separate lighting display at the Cultural Centre piazza until 11 October; both are free after dusk.

zh.headline: 康文署中秋絲燈會9月17日起亮燈維園
zh.dek: 維多利亞公園絲燈會舉行至9月27日，文化中心露天廣場光影裝置展至10月11日，黃昏後免費參觀。

en.headline: Women’s rugby series at Kai Tak awarded M Mark status
en.dek: The Major Sports Events Committee recognised the WXV Global Series Challenger, which opens on Sunday with three matches at the Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground.

zh.headline: 女子欖球挑戰賽獲M品牌 周日啟德揭幕
zh.dek: 大型體育活動事務委員會向WXV全球系列挑戰賽頒授M品牌認可，周日起一連三個比賽日在啟德青年運動場上演。

en.headline: Longsys H shares open at issue price on Hong Kong debut
en.dek: Shenzhen memory-chip maker Jiangbolong listed as 09976 at HK$236 a share after a public offer about 40 times subscribed, and opened flat before slipping a little.

zh.headline: 江波龍港股掛牌平開報236元
zh.dek: 深圳存儲器廠商江波龍今日以09976代號在港上市，發售價每股236元，公開發售約超購40倍，開市報發行價後輕微低水。

en.headline: LCSD books Charles Ng saxophone recital at City Hall in October
en.dek: Tickets at $220 went on sale for the 8 October concert in the Hong Kong Artists series, which includes two Asian premieres and a new work with composer Charles Kwong.

zh.headline: 康文署十月大會堂呈獻吳漢紳色士風演奏會
zh.dek: 「香港藝術家」系列演奏會定於10月8日晚上8晈在香港大會堂劇院舉行，票價220元已於城市售票網開售，節目包括兩首亞洲首演及一首世界首演。

en.headline: Jockey Club launches HK$134 million community basketball scheme
en.dek: A five-year programme unveiled on Monday will offer nine-month training in all 18 districts for children aged six to 16, with former NBA player Yao Ming among the guests at the kick-off.

zh.headline: 馬會撥逾1.34億推五年社區籃球計劃
zh.dek: 賽馬會「傳承接力」社區籃球計劃周一啟動，將於18區為6至16歲兒童及青年提供每年九個月訓練，前NBA球星姚明出席典禮。

en.headline: CHP records three new Legionnaires’ cases; EMSD flags three towers
en.dek: Health officials reported three community-acquired infections in a week to 5 September, while the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department found three cooling-tower samples above its action level in August.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心一周錄三宗軍團菌病 機電署三冷卻塔超標
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布8月30日至9月5日錄得三宗社區感染軍團菌病；機電工程署八月例行抽檢發現三個冷卻塔水樣本達行動水平。

en.headline: HZMB fresh-food clearance to run 24 hours from 1 October
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety will extend operating hours for designated Mainland produce arriving via the bridge from the present 16-hour window, after talks with Mainland authorities and the trade.

zh.headline: 港珠澳大橋鮮活食品10月1日起全日通關
zh.dek: 食安中心公布，經港珠澳大橋進口指定內地鮮活食品的通關時間由10月1日零晈起由每日16小時延長至全日24小時。

en.headline: Observatory issues Very Hot Weather Warning on Tuesday morning
en.dek: The warning was issued at 6.45am as the city heads for a mainly sunny and very hot day, with urban highs of about 33 degrees and isolated afternoon showers.

zh.headline: 天文台今早發出酷熱天氣警告
zh.dek: 天文台上午6晈45分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日大致天晴，日間酷熱，市區最高氣溫約33度，下午局部地區有驟雨。

en.headline: Ultraman 60th-anniversary exhibition in Mong Kok ends Sunday
en.dek: The Ultra Heroes Exhibition 2026 at INCUBASE Arena in Chong Hing Square closes on 13 September after a summer run of costumes, props and reconstructed Six Ultra Brothers scenes.

zh.headline: 旺角超人英雄展本周日結束
zh.dek: 慶祝超人系列60周年的《超人英雄展2026》在旺角創興廣場INCUBASE Arena展出至9月13日，展出拍攝用皮套、道具及昭和超人六兄弟場景。

en.headline: HKMA consults on next phase of sustainable finance taxonomy
en.dek: The Monetary Authority's Phase 2B prototype expands the list of defined green and transition activities from 25 to 39 and adds shoreline and flood measures, with comments due by 7 October.

zh.headline: 金管局就可持續金融分類目錄第2B階段諮詢
zh.dek: 金管局公布第2B階段原型，將綠色及轉型經濟活動由25項增至39項，並加入海岸及防洪適應措施，公眾可於10月7日前提交意見。

en.headline: Communications Authority fines Commercial Radio HK$120,000
en.dek: The watchdog said the AM864 English channel missed required hourly news and weather bulletins at set hours from May 2022 to April 2026 and filed inaccurate compliance records.

zh.headline: 商台英語頻道漏播新聞天氣 通訊局罰12萬
zh.dek: 通訊事務管理局裁定，商業電台AM864台由2022年5月至今年4月在指定時段未有每小時播放新聞及天氣報道，並曾提交不準確合規紀錄。

en.headline: Police seek two men after Yau Ma Tei car hits three vehicles
en.dek: A private car fled a restricted-zone stop on Nathan Road on Monday afternoon, striking two cars and a taxi; an officer was hurt trying to smash a window and the vehicle was later found abandoned in Hung Hom.

zh.headline: 油麻地私家車拒查連撞三車 警追緙兩男
zh.dek: 一輛私家車周一傍晚在彌敦道限制區落客遇查後逃走，先後撞及兩輛私家車及一輛的士，一名警員扑窗時受傷，車輛其後在紅磡被發現，車內無人。

en.headline: Reports: HZMB Hong Kong Port to trial in-car clearance in December
en.dek: Immigration is preparing a Smart Passage pilot so registered private-car drivers and passengers can clear the border without leaving their seats or showing documents, several newspapers reported.

zh.headline: 據報港珠澳口岸12月試行車上智通行
zh.dek: 多份報章報道，入境處擬於12月在港珠澳大橋香港口岸推出「智通行」先導計劃，合資格跨境私家車司機及乘客毋須下車或出示證件即可過關。

en.headline: Cavalluna equestrian show opens tonight at Kai Tak Arena
en.dek: Europe’s large-scale horse theatre production makes its Asian debut with eight performances through 13 September, presented with the Hong Kong Jockey Club.

zh.headline: 歐洲馬術劇場Cavalluna今晚啟德首演
zh.dek: 大型馬術劇場《Cavalluna – 通往異世界之門》今晚起在啟德體藝館上演，一連五天共八場，為其亞洲首演。

en.headline: Disciplinary hearings for Wang Fuk Court fire contractors postponed
en.dek: The Fire Services Department said the Registered Fire Service Installation Contractors Disciplinary Board has deferred the hearings against two companies linked to the Tai Po blaze.

zh.headline: 宏福苑兩消防承辦商紀律聆訊押後至另行通知
zh.dek: 消防處公布，原定周五就宏福苑大火兩間涉事消防裝置承辦商進行的紀律聆訊已獲委員會接納押後。

en.headline: Customs seizes 200 live crickets and 13kg of cockroaches at Lo Wu
en.dek: Two travellers were arrested after officers found the insects, commonly used as pet feed, in their baggage at the border checkpoint over the weekend.

zh.headline: 海關羅湖檢200隻活蟋蟀及13公斤蟑螂 拘兩旅客
zh.dek: 海關周末在羅湖管制站截獲兩名旅客，行李內分別藏有活體蟋蟀及杜比亞蟑螂，估計市值共約5,900元，兩人已被捕。

en.headline: FEHD prosecutes Kwai Chung café over hygiene after live mouse in takeaway
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department inspected a factory canteen in Kwai Chung after a customer reported a live young mouse in a takeaway order and found hygiene shortcomings, leading to an immediate…

zh.headline: 葵涌冰室外賣現活鼠 食環署指衞生欠佳已檢控
zh.dek: 食環署接獲投訴指市民在葵涌一間食肆購買的外賣發現懷疑幼鼠後即時巡查，發現部分地方衞生欠佳，已向經營者提出檢控並要求即時改善。

en.headline: Customs seizes 23.5kg of drugs from two passengers at airport
en.dek: Hong Kong Customs arrested a Japanese man and a British man after finding suspected cocaine and ketamine worth about HK$11 million in their baggage on Sunday; both face court on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 海關機場破兩宗販毒案 檢約23.5公斤毒品拘兩男
zh.dek: 海關周日在香港國際機場檢獲約7.5公斤懷疑可卡因及約16公斤懷疑氯胺酮等，市值約1,100萬元，拘捕一名日本籍及一名英國籍男子，兩人周二提堂。

en.headline: Science Park launches first co-create co-invest summit and fund investments
en.dek: Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation opened a six-day event linking founders, investors and industry, and announced the first investments from its HK$500 million co-acceleration fund.

zh.headline: 科技園首辦共創共投峰會 公布5億元基金首批投資
zh.dek: 香港科技園公司一連六日舉辦共創共投產業加速峰會，並公布共同企業加速基金首批四個投資項目，涵蓋氫能、物聯網及人工智能機械人等。

en.headline: Subcontractor owner admits bribery over airport third-runway contracts
en.dek: The proprietor of Carol Engineering pleaded guilty to five charges involving more than HK$5 million while a former Airport Authority general manager denied a related conspiracy charge and went on trial.

zh.headline: 機場三跑分判商東主認串謀行賄 涉逾500萬元
zh.dek: 卡樂工程東主吳啟安承認五項行賄罪，涉款逾500萬元；機管局前總經理殷國強否認控罪受審，案件押後至周二。

en.headline: Hong Kong foreign reserves stand at US$442.9 billion at end-August
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said official foreign currency reserve assets fell from US$447.9 billion at the end of July, remaining equivalent to more than five times the currency in circulation.

zh.headline: 八月底外匯儲備資產4429億美元
zh.dek: 金管局公布，香港於八月底官方外匯儲備資產為4429億美元，較七月底的4479億美元回落，仍相當於流通貨幣五倍多。

en.headline: Two travel agencies and guide lose licences over coerced shopping
en.dek: The Travel Industry Authority revoked the licences of Go Go Ming Travel Services, Grandee Travel Company and guide Sun Kwun-ying with immediate effect after finding failures to prevent coercion of mainland tour groups.

zh.headline: 兩旅行社及導遊涉威迫購物被撤銷牌照
zh.dek: 旅遊業監管局即日起撤銷幗名旅遊、伯爵旅行社的旅行代理商牌照及導遊孫觀英的牌照，指未有防止內地旅行團被威迫購物。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning in force until mid-afternoon
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Thunderstorm Warning at 12.55pm, later extended, with isolated thunderstorms expected over the territory.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至下午中段
zh.dek: 天文台下午12時55分發出雷暴警告，其後延長有效時間至下午4時15分，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Beijing robotics firm plans dozens more autonomous retail stores in Hong Kong
en.dek: Galaxy Universal, which already operates fully autonomous shops in Kai Tak, Hung Hom and Wan Chai, aims to expand into tourist areas including theme parks.

zh.headline: 銀河通用擬在港增設數十家全自主機器人零售店
zh.dek: 公司已在啟德、紅磡及灣仔開業，計劃拓展至人流密集區及主題樂園，並增加產品種類。

en.headline: Environment secretary heads to Beijing for APEC energy ministers’ meeting
en.dek: Tse Chin-wan will also meet officials from the Ministry of Ecology and Environment and the National Energy Administration during the five-day visit.

zh.headline: 謝展寰赴京出席APEC能源部長會議
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長今午啓程，期間將與生態環境部及國家能源局官員會面，周五返港。

en.headline: Didi plans autonomous vehicle tests in Tseung Kwan O this year
en.dek: A government adviser said the mainland ride-hailing firm will apply for a pilot licence, with initial trials likely starting in the industrial estate.

zh.headline: 滴滴擬今年申請將軍澳無人駕駛測試牌照
zh.dek: 運輸署工作組成員表示，內地網約車巨頭擬申請自動車先導牌照，初步測試或先於工業邨展開。

en.headline: Wear’s HK designer pop-ups run through 14 September
en.dek: Twenty Hong Kong fashion labels are showing at six malls and the airport until 14 September, part of the government-backed Hong Kong Fashion Fest.

zh.headline: 時裝薇Wear’s HK快閃店開至本月十四日
zh.dek: 第三屆香港時裝薇的全城快閃店「Wear’s HK」在六個商場及機場展出20個本地時裝品牌，活動持續至9月14日。

en.headline: Student letters to astronaut Lai Ka-ying close tonight
en.dek: The Education Bureau’s call for letters to Hong Kong payload specialist Lai Ka-ying ends at 11.59pm today, with selected pieces due to be sent to the Tiangong station later this month.

zh.headline: 給黎家盈家書今晚截止 精選作品料月中送上天宮
zh.dek: 教育局「星河有信‧港夢飛天」家書徵集今日晚上11時59分截止，邀請中小學及大專生致函首位港籍載荷專家黎家盈，精選作品預計本月中呈送天宮空間站。

en.headline: MTR reports two women on Light Rail tracks at Siu Hong
en.dek: The operator said two women entered the spare platform tracks at Siu Hong Light Rail stop on Friday afternoon and that it has reported the incident to police.

zh.headline: 兩女擅進兆康站輕鐵路軌 港鐵已報警
zh.dek: 港鐵表示，周五下午有兩名女子擅自進入輕鐵兆康站備用月台路軌範圍，公司已就事件報警，提醒乘客切勿走進路軌。

en.headline: British driver arrested after Tai Tam Road crash
en.dek: A 47-year-old man was arrested for drink-driving on Sunday night after his private car struck roadside railings on Tai Tam Road in Stanley.

zh.headline: 大潭道私家車撞欄 英籍司機涉酒駕被捕
zh.dek: 一輛私家車周日晚上在赤柱大潭道失控撞向路邊欄杆，47歲英籍男司機眼部受傷，酒精呼氣測試不合格後涉嫌酒後駕駛被捕。

en.headline: Airport cannabis case reaches court after 6kg seizure
en.dek: A 38-year-old mainland passenger arrested at Hong Kong International Airport on Saturday is due at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts today on drug-trafficking and poison charges.

zh.headline: 機場檢六公斤懷疑大麻花 內地男今日提堂
zh.dek: 海關周六在香港國際機場拘捕一名38歲內地男旅客，檢獲約六公斤懷疑大麻花及懷疑第一部毒藥產品，案件今日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Cats plays its last added week at Xiqu Centre through Sunday
en.dek: West Kowloon’s Grand Theatre hosts final extra performances of the Andrew Lloyd Webber musical from Tuesday to 13 September, after the Hong Kong run was extended twice.

zh.headline: 音樂劇《貓》戲曲中心終極加場 演至周日
zh.dek: 西九文化區戲曲中心大劇院由周二起至9月13日加開《貓》最後一輪場次，香港站已兩度延長，周一休演。

en.headline: Hong Kong Green Week opens today with five days of sustainability forums
en.dek: The third edition of the HKMA-coordinated programme runs from 7 to 11 September under the theme Future-proofing Sustainable Growth, starting with a full-day green-finance forum in Wan Chai.

zh.headline: 第三屆香港綠色周今日展開 一連五日討論可持續發展
zh.dek: 由金管局統籌的香港綠色周今日至周五舉行，主題為「賦能未來・共築可持續發展」，周一主場是灣仔的綠色金融論壇。

en.headline: Seven Hong Kong–Jakarta flights cancelled after Indonesian volcano eruption
en.dek: The Airport Authority said at least seven services between the two cities were cancelled by Sunday afternoon after ash from Anak Krakatau closed Jakarta’s main airport.

zh.headline: 印尼火山噴發 至少七班香港雅加達航班取消
zh.dek: 機管局表示，截至周日下午三時，往來香港與雅加達最少七班航班因喀拉喀托之子火山噴發取消，國泰及印尼鷹航亦取消周日及周一部分班次。

en.headline: Belt and Road Summit opens Wednesday with new Go Global chapter
en.dek: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the two-day Wan Chai gathering will add a session to help mainland firms expand overseas, as Hong Kong hosts the 11th edition of the event.

zh.headline: 一帶一路高峰論壇周三開幕 首設「走出去」環節
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波周日在網誌表示，第十一屆一帶一路高峰論壇本周三至四在灣仔會展舉行，首次增設協助內地企業出海的專題環節。

en.headline: 10-year-old boy dies after collapsing at home in Happy Valley
en.dek: Police were called to a Happy Valley flat on Sunday evening after a child was found unconscious; he was certified dead at Ruttonjee Hospital and the cause of death is pending autopsy.

zh.headline: 跑馬地10歲男童家中暈倒 送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方周日傍晚接報，跑馬地黃泥涌道一個單位有男童懷疑暈倒，男童昏迷送往律敦治醫院後證實死亡，死因有待驗屍確定。

en.headline: KMB suspends driver after staff car hits two cyclists in Sai Kung
en.dek: A Kowloon Motor Bus field car crossed the line on Tai Mong Tsai Road on Sunday morning, injuring two men on bicycles; police classed the case as a traffic accident with injury.

zh.headline: 西貢九巴外勤車撞兩單車 司機被暫停駕駛職務
zh.dek: 九巴一輛外勤私家車周日早上在大網仔路越線，撞傷兩名騎單車男子；警方列交通意外有人受傷，九巴稱已暫停涉事司機駕駛職務。

en.headline: Salt-water pipe leaks near Kai Tin Shopping Centre in Lam Tin
en.dek: A 200-millimetre salt-water main on Kai Tin Road caused muddy water to flow onto roads and through the mall; the Water Supplies Department shut the valve and said flushing-water supply was unaffected.

zh.headline: 藍田啟田商場附近鹹水管滲漏 沖廁水供應不受影響
zh.dek: 直徑200毫米鹹水供水管傍晚滲漏，黃泥水沿斜路湧出；水務署關掣後停止湧水，經調度後用戶沖廁水供應正常。

en.headline: AFCD finds three cases of large dogs without proper leashes in special operation
en.dek: The three-day enforcement action across dog-gathering spots ended on Sunday; the department will prosecute the keepers under the Dangerous Dogs Regulation.

zh.headline: 漁護署特別執法發現三宗大型狗隻未牽繩個案將檢控
zh.dek: 三日巡查於公眾地方狗隻聚集點進行，署方將跟進檢控涉事畜養人，提醒大型狗隻須用不多於兩米狗帶牽引。

en.headline: AFCD to review Po Pin Chau trail booking after high no-show rate
en.dek: Only about 1,560 registered and walk-in visitors arrived over the first two trial days despite more than 3,200 bookings; the department will assess the system after the National Day golden week.

zh.headline: 破邊洲預約制首兩日大量No Show 漁護署將全面檢討
zh.dek: 首兩個試驗日共有逾三千二百人預約，實際到場約一千五百六十人；署方表示國慶黃金周後會檢視成效。

en.headline: 72-year-old hiker dies after collapse on Ap Lei Chau’s Yuk Kwai Shan
en.dek: The man, surnamed Kwok, was found unconscious with head and leg injuries while hiking alone on Sunday morning and was airlifted to hospital, where he was certified dead.

zh.headline: 鴨脷洲玉桂山72歲行山漢送院後不治
zh.dek: 姓郭老翁今早獨自行山期間暈倒，頭腳擦傷，直升機吊起送東區醫院後證實死亡，死因有待驗屍確定。

en.headline: Labour chief open to classifying heatstroke as occupational disease
en.dek: Commissioner Sam Hui said the government will review this summer’s data on the refined heat-stress warning system before next year’s hot season and remains open to formal occupational-disease status for heatstroke.

zh.headline: 勞工處長對中暑列職業病持開放態度
zh.dek: 許澤森表示會按今夏數據檢視優化後的工作暑熱警告，明年夏季前決定是否再調節，並稱中暑列職業病須有醫學因果關係支持。

en.headline: Airport clears Terminal 2 overhead screens after safety checks
en.dek: Five suspended electronic displays at Terminal 2 have been declared safe and the cordoned area reopened; the kinetic movement feature has been permanently disabled.

zh.headline: 機管局確認T2五塊顯示屏安全 圍封區解封
zh.dek: 機場二號客運大樓懸掛顯示屏經檢查達安全標準，已加裝更多纜索並取消移動模式，相關範圍恢復開放。

en.headline: Police arrest 22-year-old over fake flag-day scam for animal charity
en.dek: A man was detained after 14 people were hired via WhatsApp to collect donations while impersonating volunteers of the Hong Kong Saving Cat and Dog Association on its approved flag day.

zh.headline: 警拘22歲男子涉假冒貓狗協會賣旗詐騙
zh.dek: 香港拯救貓狗協會合法賣旗日，有人在旺角用假旗袋混入真義工隊募捐，警方截獲14名受僱臨時工後，今日拘捕一名本地男子。

en.headline: Development Bureau highlights spatial data platform with over 1,100 datasets
en.dek: Secretary Ning Hoi-yan said the Common Spatial Data Infrastructure portal now draws data from more than 70 departments and supports applications ranging from walkability tools to hiking safety apps.

zh.headline: 發展局指空間數據共享平台已匯聚逾1100個數據集
zh.dek: 局長甯漢豪表示，平台涵蓋規劃、地政、運輸等數據，已支援步行路線工具及遠足安全應用程式。

en.headline: Ka Ying Rising extends winning streak to 21 in Chief Executive’s Cup
en.dek: The world’s top sprinter won the Group Three feature at Sha Tin by nearly eight lengths, lowering the track record on the opening day of the new season.

zh.headline: 嘉應高昇首席行政長官盃連勝第21場
zh.dek: 世界頂級短途馬周日在沙田開鑼日以近八個馬位勝出三級賽，並打破場地紀錄。

en.headline: Fatal cycling accidents more than double in first half of 2026
en.dek: Police recorded nine cycling deaths in the first six months, a 125 per cent rise, and attributed the increase to riders ignoring signals and other risky behaviour.

zh.headline: 今年上半年致命單車意外急增逾倍 九人死亡
zh.dek: 警方指首六個月錄得九宗致命單車意外，按年升125%，認為與騎車人士漠視交通燈號及危險行為有關。

en.headline: Work-week outlook: sunny periods and isolated showers, hotter midweek
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly fine weather with sunny intervals early in the week before the northeast monsoon strengthens later, bringing cooler nights and a chance of showers.

zh.headline: 下周天氣展望：初段有陽光 中後期東北季候風增強
zh.dek: 天文台預期下周初大致天晴間中有驟雨，其後東北季候風影響，風勢增強，氣溫稍降，周末或轉為較不穩定。

en.headline: Lee says five-year plan will lift livelihoods through long-term strategy
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee posted on social media that the first Hong Kong five-year plan and the Policy Address will both be issued on 16 September, with the plan setting macro strategy and the address delivering…

zh.headline: 李家超：五年規劃以長策提升民生福祉 施政報告推具體措施
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超今日在社交平台表示，香港首個五年規劃將於9月16日與施政報告同日公布，規劃以長遠策略提升民生，施政報告則每年推出房屋、民生及醫療等具體措施。

en.headline: Elderly hiker collapses on Ap Lei Chau hill, airlifted to hospital
en.dek: A man aged about 70 was found unconscious with a head injury while hiking alone on Yuk Kwai Shan on Sunday morning; Government Flying Service helicopter lifted him to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital.

zh.headline: 鴨脷洲玉桂山老翁行山昏迷 直升機吊起送院
zh.dek: 一名約70歲男子今日上午獨自行山期間暈倒頭部受傷，消防人員上山後由政府飛行服務隊直升機吊起送往東區醫院，抵院時需進行心肺復甦。

en.headline: CityU team uses green-research grant to reuse retired EV batteries
en.dek: Professor Chung Shu-hung's group received HK$6.7 million from the Low Carbon Green Research Fund to develop a smart power conditioner for second-life electric-vehicle batteries.

zh.headline: 城大獲綠色科研基金研退役電動車電池再利用
zh.dek: 電機工程學系鍾樹鴻教授團隊獲環境及生態局低碳綠色科研基金撥款六百七十萬元，研發智能功率調節器，讓退役電動車電池作一般供電。

en.headline: High-speed rail delayed after morning signalling fault
en.dek: The Transport Department said MTR reported a signalling fault shortly after 8am; at least 14 trains from West Kowloon were delayed before the operator said the fault had been cleared.

zh.headline: 高鐵今晨信號故障 西九龍多班列車延誤
zh.dek: 運輸署早上約八時二十七分接獲港鐵通知，高鐵因信號故障延誤；12306顯示至少十四班由西九龍開出的列車受影響，其後港鐵指故障已處理。

en.headline: Fujian chef Levi You opens Hokkien House in Central
en.dek: The Zhangzhou-born chef-patron, winner of the inaugural Michelin Guide Fujian Young Chef Award, began service on Friday at H Queen's on Queen's Road Central.

zh.headline: 福建年輕廚師游振龍中環開「福上」
zh.dek: 漳州出生的主廚兼東主上周五在皇后大道中H Queen's二十一樓開業，他是首屆《米芝蓮指南．福建》年輕廚師獎得主。

en.headline: Sha Tin opens the 2026/27 racing season this afternoon
en.dek: The Jockey Club starts the new season at Sha Tin from 11.15am, with the first of 10 races at 12.30pm; Horse of the Year Ka Ying Rising runs in the Chief Executive's Cup.

zh.headline: 2026/27馬季今日沙田開鑼 嘉應高昇出戰特首盃
zh.dek: 沙田馬場上午十一時十五分展開開鑼活動，首場下午十二時三十分開跑，共十場；上季馬王嘉應高昇出戰第三場香港特區行政長官盃。

en.headline: Motorcyclist left unconscious after crash at Aberdeen Tunnel exit
en.dek: A man aged about 30 was taken to Queen Mary Hospital after his scooter hit a crash barrier near the tunnel bus interchange early on Sunday; police are investigating.

zh.headline: 香港仔隧道出口綿羊仔撞欄 約30歲鐵騎士昏迷送院
zh.dek: 今晨約兩時三十五分，一輛綿羊仔駞出香港仔隧道後撞向風琴式防撞欄，鐵騎士昏迷送瑪麗醫院，警方調查原因。

en.headline: The Gruffalo plays two more shows at APA today
en.dek: Tall Stories' hour-long English musical of the Julia Donaldson picture book continues at the Wan Chai campus this afternoon, with a second weekend next week.

zh.headline: 《咕噜牛》今日在演藝學院尚有兩場
zh.dek: 根據朱莉娅唐納森繪本改編的英語音樂劇今早十一時及下午二時在灣仔演藝學院上演，下周末十一至十三日還有第二輪場次。

en.headline: Hong Kong youth squash team to make world championships debut
en.dek: Nineteen players will leave for New York next week after a send-off attended by Financial Secretary Paul Chan, the first time the city fields a youth squash side at the worlds.

zh.headline: 港青年牆球隊下周首征紐約世錦賽
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波昨日出席誓師大會，約三十名隊員之中十九人將啟程出賽，是香港首次派出青年牆球代表隊出戰世錦賽。

en.headline: Lee Cheuk Yiu and Ng Wing Lun meet in China Masters final
en.dek: The two Hong Kong shuttlers will contest the Super 750 men's singles title in Shenzhen this afternoon after both upset higher-ranked opponents on Saturday.

zh.headline: 李卓耀吳英倫會師中國大師賽男單決賽
zh.dek: 兩名港將周六先後爆冷擊敗更高排名對手，今日下午在深圳爭奪超級750男單冠軍，亦是港隊首次包辦此級別單打決賽席位。

en.headline: Kau Kee opens first retail shop after 66 years supplying fish balls to eateries
en.dek: The Mong Kok factory that has long supplied nearly 1,000 local stalls and restaurants now sells its signature fish balls and snacks directly to the public.

zh.headline: 九記魚蛋廠66年後開首間零售店 直接售予市民
zh.dek: 長年供應近千間食肆及小食檔的旺角魚蛋廠，去年底開設首間零售店，市民可直接購買招牌魚蛋及小食。

en.headline: Police arrest taxi driver for demanding five times the fare to The Peak
en.dek: Undercover officers were quoted HK$350 for a short Central-to-Peak ride that should cost about HK$66; the 69-year-old faces four charges including overcharging.

zh.headline: 警放蛇拘索五倍車資的士司機 中環往山頂收350元
zh.dek: 喬裝乘客由山頂纜車中環總站往山頂，合理車資約66元，司機索價350元；69歲男子涉四罪被捕。

en.headline: Yu Lan Cultural Festival ends today at Victoria Park
en.dek: The three-day event marking the Hungry Ghost Festival closes Sunday with competitions, workshops, an immersive theatre piece and Chiu Chow food stalls; admission is free.

zh.headline: 盂蘭文化節今日維園煞科 搶孤及互動劇場繼續
zh.dek: 一連三日的盂蘭文化節今日於銅鑼灣維多利亞公園一號球場舉行最後一天，設搶孤競賽、工作坊、實境劇場及潮汕美食攤位，免費入場。

en.headline: Tesla driver dies after collision on Island Eastern Corridor
en.dek: 54-year-old man found unconscious with no superficial injuries; police investigating possible medical episode while driving.

zh.headline: 東區走廊Tesla司機撞車後不治 警查是否駕駛時不適
zh.dek: 54歲男子昏迷送院，無表面傷痕；初步不排除暈倒後車輛失控。

en.headline: Government to hold Tiangong Classroom with Hong Kong astronaut soon
en.dek: Shenzhou-23 crew including first Hong Kong payload specialist Lai Ka-ying will give science demonstrations and hold a live dialogue with Hong Kong and Macao students.

zh.headline: 政府近日舉辦天宮課堂 黎家盈等與港澳學生天地對話
zh.dek: 神舟二十三號乘組包括首位港產載荷專家黎家盈將在空間站進行科學實驗示範，並與港澳學生實時交流。

en.headline: CHP records new mpox case; 26-year-old man in stable condition
en.dek: Patient had two high-risk contacts with a man outside Hong Kong during the incubation period; total cases since 2022 reach 100, all male.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心錄得一宗猴痘確診 26歲男情況穩定
zh.dek: 患者潛伏期內在港以外與一名男子有兩次高風險接觸；自2022年起累計100宗個案，全部為男性。

en.headline: Housing Society posts HK$1.338 billion surplus for third consecutive year
en.dek: Net assets reached HK$49.9 billion at end-March; more than 15,000 units expected to be completed over the next five financial years.

zh.headline: 房協二零二五至二六年度盈餘十三點三八億 連續三年錄得盈餘
zh.dek: 截至三月底淨資產四百九十九億元，未來五個財政年度預計落成逾一萬五千個單位。

en.headline: Fourteen fall ill after buffet at Eaton HK restaurant; premises closed for cleaning
en.dek: CHP links five clusters to The Astor at Eaton Hong Kong in Yau Ma Tei; all affected diners are stable and none required hospital admission.

zh.headline: 逸東酒店The Astor食物中毒群組增至十四人 食肆暫時停業
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心指五個群組有流行病學關連，受影響人士情況穩定，無人需入院。

en.headline: Three arrested, 1,600 unregistered vials seized in vaccine-related raids
en.dek: Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau said none of the seized items were the touted WT1 cancer-prevention product; no reports of anyone receiving the injection locally.

zh.headline: 無牌針劑搜查拘三人 檢獲一千六百劑未經註冊製品
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示檢獲物品並非聲稱的WT1防癌疫苗，暫無發現有人在港注射。

en.headline: CHP records three more severe paediatric flu cases; one girl critical
en.dek: A six-year-old girl is in critical condition with influenza A complicated by encephalopathy; a three-year-old girl and 15-year-old boy are in serious condition.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心再錄三宗兒童流感嚴重個案 一女童危殆
zh.dek: 六歲女童甲型流感併發腦病變情況危殆，三歲女童及十五歲男童情況嚴重，三人過往均健康良好。

en.headline: Lee names finance, technology and education as key growth drivers ahead of five-year plan
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee said the city’s first five-year plan would set broad strategies aligning with the national 15th five-year plan, while the Policy Address would focus on concrete measures.

zh.headline: 李家超：金融、創科、教育為五年規劃三大新增長動力
zh.dek: 行政長官在社交平台表示，首份五年規劃將訂立宏觀策略並對接國家「十五五」，施政報告則聚焦具體措施，兩者一脈相承。

en.headline: Overhead display left dangling at airport Terminal 2 after cable fault
en.dek: A suspended electronic screen at the newly reopened Terminal 2 dropped several metres on Saturday morning but was caught by its fall-arrest system; no one was hurt.

zh.headline: 機場T2離港大堂顯示屏鋼纜故障半天吊 無人受傷
zh.dek: 今早約8時半，二號客運大樓離港層一塊懸掛電子顯示屏出現故障，防墮系統即時發揮作用，無人受傷，機管局將深入調查。
